items.title: Georg Brunis Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: We used to hang around the undertakers and play cards in the afternoon. Ernie was a part-clown player and he was an embalmer.

ctx.x: Some silly joke or crazy practical joke we did. Do you remember anything about that?

Oh, an undertaker. We used to hang around the undertakers and play cards in the afternoon. Ernie was a part-clown player and he was an embalmer. So we used to sit around and Uncle Fritz was the undertaker. He looked just like Matt Berman. We used to sit around and kid around. So his cousin, Brother Lites, they'd go to the Orpheum scene, take their wives, and then if there's anything happening, they'd page him and tell him there was a body in the morgue to embalm and fix him up. So my crazy brother, Abbie, there…
I never heard anything about that.
